name: Feature Request

title: "[FEATURE] "

---

## Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you would like to see in AgentOrchestra.

## Problem / Motivation

Please describe the problem or use case that this feature would solve. What are you trying to accomplish?

**Is your feature request related to a problem?** Yes / No

If yes, please describe the problem in detail.

## Proposed Solution

Describe the solution you would like to see. Include any specific implementation details if you have them.

## Alternatives Considered

Describe any alternative solutions or features you have considered.

## Mockups / Examples (Optional)

If applicable, add mockups, diagrams, or examples of the desired feature.

## Additional Context

Add any other context about the feature request here.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have searched for existing feature requests
- [ ] I have provided a clear description of the feature
- [ ] I have described the motivation/use case
- [ ] I am willing to contribute to this feature (optional)
